name: pickup_capacitance
description: Parasitic capacitance of a superconducting pickup ring inside a closed shield can, with a dielectric support. No magnet: the 'electrostatics' section alone drives the solve. The ring is fully screened by the can, so C_ring,ring = -C_ring,can and the diagonal-dominance slack of the ring vanishes; the can keeps its capacitance to infinity.

regions.name: can
regions.notes: closed shield can (no wall on the axis)
